exposure: racial and ethnic minority groups (Black, Hispanic, Latina)
patient-provider discordance in race or gender
cohort: Postpartum patients who sought emergency care for cardiovascular complaints in a large urban care center in Southeastern Texas during their first postpartum year, between February 2012 and October 2020.
finding: The study found no significant disparities in evaluation and hospital admission rates for racial and ethnic minority postpartum patients presenting with cardiovascular complaints, nor was patient-provider demographic discordance a source of bias.
